text:
maria: Heads up — seeing a slow increase in evictions and a pattern where tiny pods are clustering on ~6 nodes, leaving medium slots fragmented and effectively unusable. median GPU slot fragmentation up ~12% over 24h.
ashok: dashboard -> https://go/redwood/metrics?panel=slot-frag (look at median and P95)
jess: can you paste a short `kubectl get pods -o wide` slice for one of the hotspots?
maria: quick snippet copied from hotspot nodes:
```
NODE       PODS  GPU_REQ
g-node-3   42    0.25
g-node-7   40    0.25
g-node-9   39    0.5
```
maria: mostly 0.25 requests filling the same few nodes.
leo: are those running with fractional scheduling or are we allocating full slots and overcommitting? :thinking: 
ashok: we rolled the 176-pack tie-breaker change last week; my hunch is the new weight inadvertently prefers packing into warm nodes instead of spreading older small pods.
scheduler-bot: deploy 176-pack rolled to 20% at 2024-06-12T09:12Z
jess: if tie-breaker favored "newer" pods, that would cause crowding. check for the affinity weight delta in the rollout config.
maria: repro attempt: launched a batch of 50 tiny pods; scheduler placed 38 on g-node-3 within ~2m.
srebot: alert: eviction-rate spike detected — ~10 evictions/min on g-node-3 over the last 15m
ashok: temporary mitigation ideas: 1) flip binpack tie-breaker to prefer spread on canary 2) bump preemption threshold so small pods get preempted/reshuffled earlier 3) add tiny-slot warmnodes to attract fractional workloads
leo: I can spin up the warmnode flavor (tiny-gpu) and test whether that smooths distribution.
jess: also verify node taints/labels from last week's infra rollout — there was an ephemeral taint we deployed that might bias placement.
maria: interestingly, removing the ephemeral taint from g-node-3 caused ~6 pods to reschedule away immediately.
ashok: WFM. proposed plan: 
- rollback the tie-breaker commit on canary scheduler (176-pack)
- relax binpack preference for small pod class for 30m window
- add a tiny-slot warmnode pool and update autoscaler profile
- run a 1h sim with 2k tiny pods to validate distribution
jess: i'll own the rollback PR and the canary patch, starting now.
leo: i'll add the warmnode flavor and prep autoscaler policy.
maria: I'll monitor evictions and median fragment metric; will post results in ~30m. thanks y'all :+1: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
